title: Barakel: The Fallen Angel
statusNote: With Multiplayer set to No, the publisher logo, main menu, help, story intro and the first area (Norgaram Neighborhoods) all work: the knight walks, and the inventory and quest log open. With Multiplayer left at Yes (the default), New Adventure stops the emulator ("RuntimeError: null function" after "Socket failed to be initialize, error code=44"). The card as dumped also carries RealPlayer and a Videos app, which the installer refuses (more than one app folder), so the zip must be packed without them.
notes: Before starting, move to Multiplayer on the main menu and press OK so it reads "Multiplayer:No". With Yes, New Adventure freezes the game here; multiplayer needs Bluetooth, which is not available.
A new adventure opens with an illustrated story that plays by itself for about 40 seconds before the first area loads.
In play the left soft key opens the menu (Play > Go to the game returns) and the right soft key the inventory. In the inventory 5 uses an object, 7 throws it away, 4 reads and 8 drinks.
Saving costs 200 gold, paid to the Wizard; after dying, use Resurrection in the game menu.

controls.source: The game's Help ("Book of help": controls during the game and in the inventory). Movement, the soft keys and the * key were also observed in play; attack, protect, spells and potion showed no visible change with no enemy near, so they stand as Help gives them. Help calls * "Enemy"; in play it showed the current adventure.

actions.up: Move up (press twice quickly to run)
actions.lsk: Game menu; next page (help, quest log)

notes: Arrows move. Space or Z attacks, X protects, C opens the spells, V drinks a potion, Tab shows the current adventure. Q is the game menu and W the inventory.
